summary: Persist locator snapshot on rebuild and daily archive to prevent full-rebuild thrashing

delivery.outcome: Verified locator snapshots remain synchronized with source_signature across full rebuilds, aborted post-rebuild reconciliations, and daily archive sweeps, eliminating stale-locator full-rebuild thrashing.
nonGoals: Changing canonical archive precedence, repair budgets, SQLite schema, store.py, or sqlite_index.py.

architecture.decision: Persist the verified built locator snapshot before acquiring mutation_lock in reconcile_index using the existing exact source_signature SQL guard, persist the current locator right after quiet full rebuilds and daily archive sweeps in server.py, increase persist_locator_snapshot timeout to 1.0s, and use a single read-only routing connection for changed-sprint ID queries in reconcile_index.
architecture.rollback: Revert this change. The persisted locator uses the existing source_locator_snapshot_v1 metadata key and exact-signature guard.

validation.evidence: Aborted post-rebuild reconciliation still persists source_locator_snapshot_v1 for built_signature, allowing subsequent reopened stored-baseline repair to reconcile without full identity scans or rebuilds.
Quiet full rebuilds in _repair_ticket_index and daily archive sweeps persist the current locator snapshot immediately.
All index repair, discovery, and governance checks pass cleanly.
